sources.entry: OpenClean - Free Mac cleaner that explains each item, quarantines what it removes for undo, and includes an app uninstaller, disk map and menu bar monitor.

summary.one_liner: OpenClean is a free, open-source Mac cleaner that explains each cleanup item and quarantines removed files so they can be restored.
summary.what_it_does: Smart Scan finds caches, logs, Trash and other leftovers and states why each is safe to remove. The app includes an uninstaller that removes an app along with the files it leaves behind. Space Lens maps disk usage and finds large, old and duplicate files. It has developer-tool cleanup for Xcode, npm, Cargo, Docker, AI model downloads and old project folders. A menu bar monitor shows CPU, GPU, memory, disk and network usage. Items that are not trivially rebuilt go to a quarantine and can be restored from History for up to 90 days (7 by default). Cleaning rules are plain readable files.
use_cases: clean up junk and caches on a Mac
uninstall a Mac app and its leftover files
find large or duplicate files taking up disk space
clean Xcode, npm, Docker or Cargo leftovers
monitor CPU, memory and network from the menu bar
undo an accidental file deletion on macOS
how_to_run: Or download the latest .dmg from the Releases page and drag OpenClean to Applications
notable: Quarantines removed files so they can be restored from History for up to 90 days
Explains why each cleanup item is safe to remove
Cleaning rules are plain, readable files
Signed and notarized by Apple, runs on Apple silicon and Intel
No account or tracking; only a daily update check, which can be disabled
caveats: Needs Full Disk Access once, and an administrator password to clean system caches
Independent project, not affiliated with MacPaw/CleanMyMac
keywords: free up disk space on mac
